table.name: Solid perception
table.q: Whose world is this?
table.diff: One body owns the frame: either we see through its eyes (POV, eyelid/mask/windscreen framing) or we see it held at the hub with everything else arranged around it — and the image would lose its organising centre if that body were removed.

table.name: Liquid perception
table.q: Does perception migrate?
table.diff: The centre moves: in a continuous reframing the shot passes from one character or environment to another, each central only until the next captures the screen.

table.name: Gaseous perception
table.q: Can the world perceive without a human center?
table.diff: Nothing is privileged: through slow/fast motion, superimposition, fragmentation or micro-shooting the image treats a human figure as one image like any other among landscapes, matter and machines.

table.name: Icon
table.q: Where does intensity become a face?
table.diff: The face is not a feature of a person in a space but the whole image: a close-up in which expression (fixed wonder or traversing micro-movements) holds an intensity that has not yet become action.

table.name: Dividual
table.q: Is the feeling mine, ours, or both?
table.diff: The feeling belongs to the gathering: the crowd, pack or series of faces is individualised as one affect while each person in it is de-individualised.

table.name: Any-space-whatever
table.q: Has place stopped functioning as ordinary geography?
table.diff: Affect with no face: an emptied, disconnected or amorphous space (fog, rain, shadow, coloured void, ruin, haze) that expresses a quality itself rather than locating an action.

table.name: Symptom
table.q: What force is acting through this body?
table.diff: The body acts from a drive too strong for it: a visible primordial act (devouring, rutting, seizing, cruelty) in which the human behaves as a human animal, not as an agent with a goal.

table.name: Fetish
table.q: What object has become charged?
table.diff: A partial object is held apart and charged — relic or vult — so that the image makes us feel stored primal force in it, waiting for a body to discharge it.

table.name: Originary world
table.q: What ancient or pre-social force underlies this milieu?
table.diff: Beneath a recognisable place rumbles an archetypal one: the forest, desert, swamp or house is shown as a determinate but timeless ground of drives and decay, not as a historical setting.

table.name: Index of lack
table.q: What missing situation does this action let us infer?
table.diff: Something is visibly missing from the situation (an ellipsis) and the character's action fills it in one unequivocal disclosure that then redirects what they do.

table.name: Index of equivocity
table.q: What two worlds could explain the same action?
table.diff: An action discloses a situation that stays double: a slight difference in the same act refers it to two distant situations at once — 'this and that' — and the film sustains the undecidability.

table.name: Vector
table.q: How do several incomplete situations compose a world?
table.diff: Many characters each disclose a partial, equivocal situation, and only their interlocking over the film draws the broken, unpredictable but necessary line of one world.

table.name: Milieu
table.q: What world produces these actions?
table.diff: The situation is given before anyone acts: an establishing or extreme wide shot lays out a determined geo-historical and social space, and the people in it exemplify it rather than change it.

table.name: Binomial
table.q: Where has the world become a duel?
table.diff: Two opposed lines of force, embodied in characters, face each other: the image is organised as a duel (violent, romantic, political) pointing toward a decisive confrontation.

table.name: Imprint
table.q: How has the world gotten inside the character?
table.diff: A complex situation has entered one body: the character carries it as visible, contained pressure, often fixed on an emotional object that links them to the world, before (or as) it bursts into action.

table.name: Plastic figure
table.q: What greater situation does this action unexpectedly imply?
table.diff: Does a single on-screen object, action or cut stand in, in one stroke, for a real situation that is never itself shown (metaphor/metonymy/synecdoche), while the film's own drive is still action discovering situation?

table.name: Theatrical figure
table.q: What real action is being rehearsed through fiction?
table.diff: Is a fictitious action (performance, game, allegory, parody) being played out over a sequence as a precursor of a real action that has not yet happened and keeps being deferred?

table.name: Mise en abyme
table.q: Is one action-world nested inside another?
table.diff: Do figures nest inside figures such that, watching, you cannot say whether a performed sequence contains an emblematic image or an emblematic image contains the performed sequence?

table.name: Figure of the sublime
table.q: Is the action bigger than the world requires?
table.diff: Does the character's action visibly exceed anything the situation requires, so that the grandiose act makes the situation look futile (a steamship hauled over a mountain)?

table.name: Figure of enfeeblement
table.q: Is the actor tiny compared with the world disclosed?
table.diff: Do a weak character's small, futile acts make an immense, indifferent world swell into view (the tiny point fleeing to the horizon), rather than the world merely sitting there?

table.name: Quotidian
table.q: Has everyday life become both ridiculous and heroic?
table.diff: Is an everyday act shown so that you cannot decide whether it is trivial or heroic, the situation both inconsequential and unfathomable at once?

table.name: Limit of the large form action-image
table.q: What hidden question does this world contain?
table.diff: Before acting, does the character have to extract a question hidden in the situation (what is a samurai now?), so action is delayed into a considered response rather than an explosive reaction?

table.name: Limit of the small form action-image
table.q: Why do the clues refuse to settle the situation?
table.diff: Do parallel, heterogeneous lines of action connect only as pieces from different puzzles, so the situation they reveal remains an unanswered cipher, a sustained ellipsis?

table.name: Limit of the action-image (extreme limit)
table.q: Has action itself stopped being an adequate solution?
table.diff: Is the film permeated by problems from start to end so that you can no longer tell whether they are posed by the situation or discovered by action, the world itself appearing as a field of indeterminate forces?

table.name: Rich dream
table.q: Can we clearly tell when the dream begins?
table.diff: Is the passage into the dream explicitly marked and ornately made (dissolves, superimpositions, effects), with an equally marked exit, so the dream is attributed to a dreamer and recognised as dream by the viewer?

table.name: Restrained dream
table.q: Are we unsure whether waking has ended?
table.diff: Is the dream entered by an invisible cut and made of concrete everyday things with one impossible unhinging, so that the film's task becomes deciding whether we are awake?

table.name: Movement of world
table.q: What if nobody ever wakes up?
table.diff: Is there no entry or exit at all: does the world itself carry the character along (song, dance, impossible events treated as natural) so that no one is the dreamer?

table.name: Strong destiny
table.q: Does the remembered past command what happens next?
table.diff: Does a marked flashback (pause, dissolve, monochrome, reverb) return to the present and pass through affect into an action it determines, closing a causal circuit?

table.name: Weak destiny
table.q: Does memory color the present without dictating it?
table.diff: Is the flashback ambiguous, incomplete or shared, so it saturates present feeling as a clue to an ellipsis that must be reconstructed before any action can follow?

table.name: Forking paths
table.q: Which past, if any, actually explains the present?
table.diff: Do flashbacks fork within flashbacks, irreconcilably, so the past is explored for its own sake as an inexplicable secret and psychological causality is shown to be a ruse?

table.name: Mark
table.q: What recurring thing has become meaningful because it repeats?
table.diff: Can you point to at least three occurrences of the same image or motif that the characters or viewer come to read as one habitual series with a meaning to be deciphered?

table.name: Demark
table.q: What breaks the pattern?
table.diff: Does the shot show a known term of an established series appearing out of place or contradicting that series, so that the aberration itself shocks thought?

table.name: Symbol
table.q: What idea is being thought through this thing?
table.diff: Is a single concrete object held on screen as the knot where several separate threads of the film's relations meet, so that it carries an idea, belief or concept rather than a use or a desire?

table.name: Opsign
table.q: Can this sight still be discharged into action?
table.diff: With the sound off, is the image something to be seen and nothing more: no one's goal organises it, what moves in it resolves nothing, and the look is not converted into action?

table.name: Sonsign
table.q: Does this sound stand alone as a situation, answered by no action?
table.diff: With the image covered, does a sound hold the scene as a situation in itself, not score, not plot-driving dialogue, not a cue someone answers?

table.name: Mirrors face to face
table.q: Which image is original?
table.diff: Does one body or thing appear in the same shot as several reflections or doubles at once (facing, angled or distorting mirrors, glass), so that actual and virtual can no longer be told apart?

table.name: Limpid and opaque
table.q: Which side of the image is becoming real?
table.diff: During the shot or scene, does one face of the image clear (becomes visible or real) while the other clouds (becomes obscure or virtual), so that the two sides keep changing places?

table.name: Seed and environment
table.q: What future world lies virtually inside this image?
table.diff: Is there a small enclosed image (a snow globe, model, miniature stage, a drop, a crystal) that contains in germ the world that surrounds it or will grow from it, with seed and environment reversible?

table.name: Peaks of the present
table.q: What if several presents are simultaneously valid?
table.diff: Does the narration give several different presents at once (a present of the past, a present of the present, a present of the future) in the same event, without flashback framing to rank them?

table.name: Sheets of the past
table.q: Which layer of the past are we inhabiting?
table.diff: Does the film move between regions of the past that coexist and ricochet non-chronologically (layered periods in one space, without a present-day narrator motivating each return)?

table.name: Powers of the false
table.q: What if contradiction generates rather than obstructs the story?
table.diff: Does the film expose its own claim to truth, with testimony, performance or versions that pass into one another so that no image can be held as the true one?

table.name: Bodies of attitude
table.q: What does the body think before it acts?
table.diff: Is the body shown waiting, tired, slumped or posing, in its everydayness, with the posture itself as the content and no act prepared or completed?

table.name: Bodies of gest
table.q: How do postures become social relations?
table.diff: Are postures chained into a visible, repeated or staged gesture that performs a social act (ritual, bureaucratic routine, demonstration) and is shown as performance, not as efficient action?

table.name: Cinema of the brain
table.q: Has the screen itself become a thinking system?
table.diff: Is the set or world laid out as a map of thought (abstract floor plans, chalk-drawn spaces, landscapes as mental states), so that the screen reads as a brain rather than a place to act in?

table.name: Lectosigns
table.q: What must I read here that I cannot simply see?
table.diff: Does grasping the film require you to relink its images, narration and narrative yourself, because none of them links 'naturally' and no single key object resolves it?
